name: Northridge Fashion Center
description: Northridge Fashion Center is a premier shopping destination in Los Angeles featuring over 170 stores offering everything from luxury items to favorite national brands. The mall provides family-friendly dining options onsite and serves as a comprehensive retail hub for the community. With flexible leasing opportunities and modern amenities, it's designed to appeal to every taste and budget.
summary: A major regional shopping center in Los Angeles with 170+ stores ranging from luxury retailers to national brands, plus diverse dining options.
